summary.status: BLOCKED ON LIVE ACCEPTANCE, HARDWARE, AND CREDENTIALS

blockers.title: Multi-OS 72-hour physical fleet hardware soak
blockers.description: Validation on physical hardware matrix (Apple Silicon M-series, low-end x86, NVIDIA discrete GPU, multi-DPI physical monitors, Bluetooth audio transitions) cannot execute on virtual CI or single dev workstation.
blockers.blocking_reason: Physical test hardware fleet not provisioned in current environment. Software scaffolding and fault-injection simulations are complete, but physical soak hours cannot be claimed without reproducible execution.
blockers.resolution_criteria: Execute continuous 24h and 72h soak runs across target physical machines using scripts/soak-collect.mjs; record metrics meeting frozen thresholds in tests/soak/matrix.json.

blockers.title: Production code signing and notarization credentials
blockers.description: Production Authenticode certificate for Windows, Apple Developer ID Application certificate + notarization credentials for macOS, and Tauri updater private signing key are not provisioned in CI secrets.
blockers.blocking_reason: External signing identities withheld from repository code by design to prevent credential exposure.
blockers.resolution_criteria: Provision valid certificates and keys in GitHub repository secrets; verify that release-preflight.mjs exits 0 in CI publish pipeline.

blockers.title: Cross-platform semantic desktop adapters require live acceptance
blockers.description: Windows UI Automation with Win32 fallback, macOS Accessibility/AX, and Linux AT-SPI semantic adapters are implemented. Representative physical desktop inspect/act/verify tasks have not yet been executed across the supported OS matrix.
blockers.blocking_reason: Plan 02 code is implemented, but its definition of done requires representative live semantic tasks on each supported OS.
blockers.resolution_criteria: Pass representative inspect/act/verify tasks on physical Windows, macOS, and Linux desktop sessions, including permissions, modal dialogs, DPI and privilege-boundary cases.
blockers.verification_step: Run the Plan 02 representative desktop task matrix on Windows, macOS, and Linux and attach reproducible logs.

blockers.title: Signed updater activation and rollback require clean-machine acceptance
blockers.description: Verified artifact staging, installer extension preservation, platform activation, executable backup metadata, and deferred rollback recovery are implemented. A production-signed clean-machine update/forced-failure rollback drill is still required.
blockers.blocking_reason: Release acceptance requires proving the implemented activation/recovery path with production-signed artifacts on clean Windows and macOS machines.
blockers.resolution_criteria: Execute a production-signed install, forced-failure rollback, and clean-machine recovery drill on Windows and macOS and attach reproducible logs.
blockers.verification_step: Execute a signed install, forced-failure rollback, and clean-machine recovery drill on Windows and macOS.

known_limitations.title: Direct in-process CrispASR C-ABI streaming is unavailable upstream
known_limitations.description: ReflexDesk streams PCM into Rust and generates genuine partial hypotheses through its authenticated ephemeral loopback engine. The upstream CrispASR release does not currently expose a stable packaged shared-library ABI, so native_streaming_supported remains false rather than enabling the unauthenticated 0.0.0.0 listener.
known_limitations.impact: Low for functionality: offline partial/final voice control works through the authenticated local engine. Direct in-process FFI remains a future optimization once a stable upstream ABI exists.

known_limitations.title: Ambiguous planner requests may require an optional model backend
known_limitations.description: The built-in planner is available on fresh install and handles explicit app/browser/desktop-focus/agent and sequenced commands. Requests outside the deterministic grammar fail closed with planner-needs-model unless an optional local model endpoint is configured.
known_limitations.impact: Low for ordinary explicit control; intentionally ambiguous or open-ended planning is not guessed without a model.

process.review_frequency: Weekly and prior to any release candidate build
process.blocker_addition_policy: Any P0 or P1 defect discovered during soak or security audit automatically creates an entry here with status OPEN
process.blocker_closure_policy: Can only transition to RESOLVED with passing reproducible automated test or signed physical hardware log reference
